dreamteamer.title: Artifacts
dreamteamer.description: `artifacts`: a built page someone OPENS — a pitch, a prototype, a report, a canvas — kept as a folder whose `index.md` carries the fields and the tour and whose `index.html` runs straight from disk; a published copy is recorded on `published_url`. Not `assets`, which are pictures a view draws. Peers `companies`.
